column1: # Bengali pronunciation lexicon — genuinely-LEXICAL whole-word overrides for the vowel classes the rule engine
# cannot derive (closed-syllable ɔ→o and final-[o] retention; PROVEN lexical by the minimal pair মন[mon] vs
# কম[kɔm], identical shape, opposite outcome — an etymological tatsama/tadbhava split, not surface-derivable).
# PROVENANCE: each entry is our engine's own consonant skeleton with the vowel(s) set to the CROSS-SOURCE
# CONSENSUS of two INDEPENDENT human references — wikipron ben (CC BY-SA, Kolkata-leaning) AND Bengali.AI
# DUAL-IPA (Dhaka; used OFFLINE for validation only, not redistributed). Requiring two different dialects to
# AGREE filters out both wikipron noise and dialect-specific forms (it correctly ABSTAINS on জীবন→d͡ʒibɔn, where
# the sources disagree). Pronunciations are linguistic facts. Overrides SHIPPED whole-word output only; the rule
# engine (phonemizeWordRules) — and therefore the referee-eval — is unaffected and stays the honest signal.
